comment: The adverts explainer: scene lengths (frames at 30 fps), the captions over the recording (frames within it), and the frames sfx/adverts.mjs puts its sounds on.

captions.text: Every seat on the plane, front to back. Open a cabin to see its seats.
Each holder can put an image on their seat. No advert yet? It carries Seat Airlines' house ads.
The best spots are at the front, and you get them by holding. Row 1 isn't for sale.
See its advert, description and link, with the holder, their rank and their bag.
